Here is a Python program that generates a palindrome of length 255:

```python
def generate_palindrome(length):
    # Generate first half of the string
    half = ''.join(str(i) for i in range(1, (length+1)//2 + 1))

    # Create full palindrome by concatenating half with its reverse
    palindrome = half + half[::-1]

    return palindrome

# Generate a palindrome of length 255
palindrome = generate_palindrome(255)

print(palindrome)
```

This program first generates the first half of the string as a sequence of numbers from 1 to `(length+1)//2`. It then creates the full palindrome by appending the reverse of this half to itself.
